name: boros_charm_double_strike_on_the_one_target_creature
notes: Printed: 'Target creature gains double strike until end of turn.' Third mode (token 2). Seat 0 gives its 2/2 Duelist double strike and attacks with it and with a 3/3 Brawler that was not targeted; seat 1 has no blockers. The Duelist deals 2 in the first-strike damage step and 2 again in the regular step (4), the Brawler 3 once: seat 1 goes 20 -> 13.
